item.title: Hubble 2.2.3-beta.7
item.description:
# Hubble 2.2.3 beta 7
- **Wide key faces on a Stream Deck Studio.** On Companion 5, Hubble now draws each key face in the shape of the device chosen for its page in **Button layout**. On a **Stream Deck Studio** page the face is wide and fills the Studio's wider keys from edge to edge. Before, it was drawn narrower and slightly soft, and it dimmed the key's text. - Pages for other decks get square faces drawn at that deck's own key size (96 × 96 on an XL), so they stay sharp. A page with no device chosen uses 96 × 96. - To draw every page wide, open the Hubble connection's settings in Companion and set **Key shape** to **Stream Deck Studio (wide) on every page**. - Companion 4 draws every key square, so on Companion 4 the faces look the same as before. - **Button layout shows a Stream Deck Studio page with wide keys.** The keys are as wide as they are on the device. Dials stay round. - **Updating the Hubble module in Companion no longer stops timed keys from syncing.** When Companion updated the Hubble module, it marked every Hubble action as upgraded. Hubble read that as someone having edited the keys, so it stopped saving workbook changes to keys with long presses and showed "A managed Hubble action was edited". Hubble now ignores that mark, and it still notices a real edit.
This beta includes version **0.3.7** of the Hubble module for Companion. To get the wide faces, choose **Install / Reinstall** in **Module Connections** or **Button layout**, or **Update in Companion** in Hubble → **Service Settings…**. When the module updates, Companion adds a **Key page** field to each Hubble key's appearance. Leave it as it is.
Nothing in your configuration changes. This beta opens the same configuration as 2.2.3 beta 6.
This is a beta. It reaches Macs that have turned on **Get beta updates** in Hubble's **Check for Updates…** window.

item.title: Hubble 2.2.2
item.description:
# Hubble 2.2.2
- **One look for every on/off setting.** True/false cells in the Button Matrix, module page tables and module sheets, and every checkbox in settings and dialogs, now show the guided setup checklist's mark: a green circle with a white tick when on and an empty ring when off. Every on/off switch now looks like the Module Connections switch, with On or Off under it. The ticks in column menus are unchanged. - **Enter moves down on every Button Matrix cell.** Action cells, router SRC and DST, Text Size and other list cells now move to the cell below on Enter, like other spreadsheets. Typing, Option, a double-click or the cell's arrow still opens the list, and Enter in an open list still picks the highlighted choice. Module spreadsheets are unchanged. - **Module updates on the Module Connections page.** A Module updates group at the start of the Companion plugin bar sets the automatic-update default that modules follow unless they have their own choice, shows when the catalog was last read, and has Check for module updates. A module's Updates tab keeps its own version controls. The Data access tabs are gone: Allow access to other modules' data is now the last section of Settings, and every module can read the Button Matrix's shared columns without a grant. - **A clearer Import workspace dialog.** It has three mode tabs, one card per workspace with its modules folded away, a From the file or Copy current choice for each module, and a footer that says what will happen or what still needs a choice. Spreadsheet only lists the modules the buttons use. - **Easier keyboard use.** Ctrl+Tab and Ctrl+Shift+Tab move between the sidebar, toolbar, grid, sheet tabs, Advanced action panel and Variables. The Columns menu steps one column per arrow key, and Option-Up or Option-Down moves the highlighted column. Add Action Column starts in its first field and returns to the grid when closed. Connection fields and Advanced text areas show a focus ring, and Tab no longer lands on the closed sidebar. - **Smaller fixes.** The Collapsed fields submenu stays open while you tick several fields. Fill Module Connection Down is gone from the action column menu. HubDash no longer redraws for every log line, small buttons are easier to hit, and the window no longer flashes two shades at launch.
